features.label: Toughness
features.description: Hard living has thickened your hide. Your maximum hit points increase each time you take this perk.

features.label: Alert
features.description: You are hard to catch off guard, gaining a sizeable edge on initiative and immunity to being surprised.

features.label: Power Attack
features.description: You put your whole body behind each swing, dealing extra melee damage.

features.label: Deadeye
features.description: Your aim finds the gaps. Ranged attacks (with bows, crossbows, guns, or throwing weapons) land critical hits more often.

features.label: Shield Wall
features.description: You turn a shield into a fortress, blocking a greater share of incoming damage.

features.label: Pyromancer
features.description: Flame answers your call more fiercely, increasing the damage of Red Magic.

features.label: Ghost
features.description: You move like a shadow, far harder to detect while sneaking.

features.label: Silver Tongue
features.description: Your words open doors and purses alike, improving persuasion and barter prices.

features.label: Field Medic
features.description: Your mundane healing is markedly more effective.

features.label: Gifted
features.description: You are exceptionally talented, but lean on raw aptitude over study: +1 to every attribute, and each level-up's skill-point pool is 10% smaller. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Fast Shot
features.description: You attack quickly but recklessly: your ranged attacks are 20% faster, and you cannot make aimed shots. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Small Frame
features.description: You are slight of build: +1 Agility, but you carry 25% less. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Genius
features.description: A quick study with room for one more focus, at the cost of breadth: one more tag skill, and 15 fewer starting skill points. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Undead Phobia
features.description: The walking dead fill you with primal terror: you are frightened while an undead is in sight. Facing that fear has hardened you: +2 Willpower, and 25% less taken from undead, poison, and disease. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Beast Phobia
features.description: You have a deep fear of wild beasts and monstrous animals: you are frightened while a beast is in sight. Living around them taught you their ways: +1 Strength and +10 Animal Handling. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Leather Allergy
features.description: Leather and animal hides bring painful rashes and breathing trouble: you gain nothing from leather or hide items, so most common light armor is off-limits. +1 Endurance. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Iron Allergy
features.description: Common iron and steel burn your flesh and interfere with your magic: you gain no full benefit from iron or steel items, and must seek rarer materials. +1 Intelligence, and an affinity for exotic materials (silver, elven wood). Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Silver Sensitivity
features.description: Silver is toxic to your body: you gain nothing from silver items. Something in your blood answers the unholy: 30% less taken from undead, and a 10% chance to absorb a hostile spell as mana. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Arcane Phobia
features.description: Magic and magically made beings terrify you: you are frightened while a construct is in sight. Your mind clenches against spells: 20% less taken from hostile magic, and a 15% chance to absorb a hostile spell as mana. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Heavy Armor Expert
features.description: You have trained extensively in heavy plate. The stamina and AP surcharges for demanding actions are halved (x1.5 instead of x2.0 for dodge, etc.).

features.label: Light Foot
features.description: You move with grace even in medium armor. All medium armor stamina and AP surcharges on movement and dodging are eliminated.

features.label: Brutal Charge
features.description: You barrel through enemies in heavy armor. Power attacks and charges cost stamina equal to a light attack - the heavy surcharge is negated.

features.label: Acrobat
features.description: You are exceptionally nimble and coordinated. Dodge rolls cost 25% less stamina, and you recover from knockdowns faster.

features.label: Scavenger
features.description: You know where the good stuff hides: under the floorboards, in the lining of a purse, behind the den. Every loot roll you make is better.

features.label: Cleave
features.description: When a melee blow drops a foe, the swing carries into one more within reach.

features.label: Crushing Blow
features.description: Your hammer and mace blows dent plate; they ignore 2 points of armor DR.

features.label: Precise Thrust
features.description: Spear and rapier find the gaps: piercing attacks crit on 5 more.

features.label: Brawler
features.description: Tavern-floor fighting hardened your fists: +2 unarmed damage per rank.

features.label: Iron Fist
features.description: Your strikes land like a cudgel: +50% unarmed damage.

features.label: Quick Draw
features.description: A weapon is in your hand before the thought is finished: swapping costs 1 AP less.

features.label: Steady Aim
features.description: You line up a shot without wasting breath: an aimed attack costs 1 AP less.

features.label: Sniper
features.description: Distance matters less to you: range penalties are halved.

features.label: Duelist
features.description: One on one, your blade reads every opening: +10 to attack when only one foe engages you.

features.label: Second Wind
features.description: Once per rest, when you fall below half health, you catch your breath and recover 20 HP.

features.label: Unstoppable
features.description: Blows that rock others barely move you: you cannot be staggered.

features.label: Berserker
features.description: Pain feeds your fury: +20% damage below half HP, but -10 evasion.

features.label: Executioner
features.description: Your critical blows are final: +50% critical damage.

features.label: Thrown Mastery
features.description: Knives and axes leave your hand with killing weight: +2 thrown damage.

features.label: Fast Reload
features.description: You crank and load in one motion: reloading costs 1 AP less.

features.label: Gunslinger
features.description: You fire from the hip and still hit the heart: guns crit on 5 more.

features.label: Arcane Reservoir
features.description: Your pool of mana runs deeper: +10 maximum MP per rank.

features.label: Mana Flow
features.description: Mana returns to you faster: +25% MP regeneration.

features.label: Battle Mage
features.description: You have learned to cast in a hauberk: the armor penalty on casting is halved.

features.label: Spell Penetration
features.description: Your spells pierce wards: they ignore 5 points of resist.

features.label: Elemental Harmony
features.description: You weave phases that feed each other: the generating cycle multiplies 0.25 more for you.

features.label: Healer
features.description: Your restoration knits deeper: +15% Green Magic magnitude per rank.

features.label: Illusionist
features.description: Your illusions linger: +25% Yellow Magic duration.

features.label: Conjurer
features.description: What you call stays longer: +50% summon duration.

features.label: Dire Summons
features.description: What you call comes bigger and fiercer: your summons gain the dire template, and your Orange Magic +5.

features.label: Elder Summons
features.description: What you call comes old and seasoned: your summons gain the elder template in place of dire, and your Orange Magic +5.

features.label: Ancient Summons
features.description: What you call is older than the realm: your summons gain the ancient template in place of elder, and your Orange Magic +5.

features.label: Commanding Summons: Magic
features.description: Your will reaches into what you call: each creature you summon adds your CHA modifier (CHA - 5, never below 0) to its INT and WIL, and your Persuasion +5. Take Commanding Summons: Physical as well for its body.

features.label: Commanding Summons: Physical
features.description: Your presence drives what you call: each creature you summon adds your CHA modifier (CHA - 5, never below 0) to its STR, END, and AGI, and your Intimidation +5. Take Commanding Summons: Magic as well for its mind.

features.label: Demonic Pact
features.description: What you call is touched by the fiends: your summons gain the demonic template, in place of any other nature, and you resist fire 5.

features.label: Angelic Covenant
features.description: What you call is touched by the heavens: your summons gain the angelic template, in place of any other nature, and you resist radiant 5.

features.label: Otherworldly Call
features.description: What you call is touched by somewhere else: your summons gain the otherworldly template, in place of any other nature, and you resist psychic 5.

features.label: Transmuter
features.description: Your alterations hold: +25% Blue Magic duration.

features.label: Telekinetic
features.description: Your force reaches farther: +50% Indigo Magic range.

features.label: Unraveler
features.description: You see the knots in a spell: your dispels end spells of one more level.

features.label: Zealot
features.description: Your faith burns bright: +15% White Magic magnitude per rank.

features.label: Necromancer
features.description: The dead answer more readily: you can hold one more thrall.

features.label: Warded Mind
features.description: Your thoughts are a locked room: +10 against charm, fear, and sleep.

features.label: Quick Caster
features.description: Your gestures are economical: casting costs 1 AP less.

features.label: Archmage
features.description: Mastery makes magic cheap: spells cost 20% less mana.

features.label: Haggler
features.description: You never pay the first price: 5% better barter prices.

features.label: Intimidating Presence
features.description: People step aside before you ask: +10 to intimidation.

features.label: Smooth Liar
features.description: Your lies come with a warm smile: +10 to deception.

features.label: Empath
features.description: You read a face like a page: +10 to insight.

features.label: Leader
features.description: Allies who can see you fight better: +5 to their attack.

features.label: Diplomat
features.description: Even a drawn sword can be talked down: you may parley with hostile foes.

features.label: Streetwise
features.description: You know who buys what nobody should sell: +10% when fencing.

features.label: Menacing
features.description: A critical hit from you shakes the foe: they are frightened.

features.label: Trap Sense
features.description: A loose stone, a taut thread: +15 to detect traps.

features.label: Light Fingers
features.description: Purses open themselves for you: +10 to sleight of hand.

features.label: Locksmith
features.description: Tumblers talk to you: +10 to lockpick.

features.label: Backstab
features.description: A blade from the dark bites deeper: +50% damage on a sneak attack.

features.label: Assassin
features.description: Your sneak attacks always crit.

features.label: Scholar
features.description: Years in the stacks pay off: +10 to lore.

features.label: Polyglot
features.description: Tongues come easily to you: you know two more languages.

features.label: Quick Learner
features.description: You learn from everything: +2 skill points per level.

features.label: Tracker
features.description: Bent grass and a scuffed stone tell you the way: +10 to survival.

features.label: Beast Friend
features.description: Animals trust you: +10 to animal handling.

features.label: Iron Stomach
features.description: Bad water and worse food rarely bother you: 25% resistance to poison and disease.

features.label: Pack Mule
features.description: You carry what others leave behind: +25 carry per rank.

features.label: Fleet-Footed
features.description: You cover ground quickly: +1 speed.

features.label: Tinkerer
features.description: Broken things want to work for you: +10 to repair.

features.label: Master Alchemist
features.description: Your brews are stronger: +25% potion magnitude.

features.label: Master Smith
features.description: Your forge work comes out one quality grade higher.

features.label: Lucky
features.description: Once per rest, you may roll a check again and keep the second roll.

features.label: Fortune Favored
features.description: Luck leans your way in a fight: you crit on 3 more.

features.label: Iron Will
features.description: Fear finds no purchase in you: you cannot be frightened.

features.label: Meditative
features.description: A short rest settles your mind: +50% MP recovered when resting.

features.label: Night Eyes
features.description: Your eyes adjust to the dark: darkvision to 6 units.

features.label: Survivor
features.description: Once per rest, a blow that would drop you leaves you at 1 HP instead.

features.label: Shield Training
features.description: You angle the shield to take the blow on its boss: a block subtracts 2 more damage.

features.label: Spell Ward
features.description: Your shield catches fire and force as well as steel: a block also stops a single or area spell of any type, at half shield DR. An instant spell still cannot be blocked.

features.label: Bulwark
features.description: A perfect block turns the blow aside entirely: a critical block negates the hit.

features.label: Sidestep
features.description: A half step is all you need: the dodge action costs 1 AP less.

features.label: Armored Evasion
features.description: You have learned to move in your armor: +10 to evade, which offsets what armor costs you.

features.label: Riposte
features.description: When you slip a blow perfectly you answer it: a critical evade of a single attack lets you make one attack at no AP cost.

features.label: Versatility
features.description: You begin with one additional tag skill.

features.label: Ambition
features.description: You may take one bonus perk at 1st level (any perk whose prerequisites you already meet).

features.label: Darkvision
features.description: You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, out to 12 units.

features.label: Fey Ancestry
features.description: You resist charm and mind-affecting magic, and cannot be magically put to sleep.

features.label: Keen Senses
features.description: +10 to detection (Perception) checks.

features.label: Woodland Stride
features.description: Difficult terrain of plants and undergrowth costs you no extra movement.

features.label: Sunless Sight
features.description: Your darkvision extends to 24 units, but you have disadvantage on checks in bright sunlight.

features.label: Shadowmeld
features.description: +10 to stealth while in dim light or darkness.

features.label: Darkvision
features.description: You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, out to 12 units.

features.label: Dwarven Resilience
features.description: You resist poison and disease, taking a quarter less from both.

features.label: Stoneworker
features.description: +10 to Repair and crafting checks.

features.label: Dwarven Toughness
features.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per level.

features.label: Mountain Armor Training
features.description: You are proficient with light and medium armor.

features.label: Beastfolk
features.description: Marks the race as beastfolk. A kin typically defines natural-weapon and heightened-sense traits, but no values are inherited from the template or from sibling kin.

features.label: Retractable Claws
features.description: Your claws are natural weapons dealing 1d6 slashing damage.

features.label: Cat's Landing
features.description: You take no damage from falls of 4 units or less and always land on your feet.

features.label: Pack Tactics
features.description: +10 to attack checks against a foe that an ally is also engaging.

features.label: Keen Smell
features.description: +10 to detection checks that rely on scent.
